project_type: Node.js CLI application - Proof-of-Work mining tool
build_system: npm with no build step (plain JS, no transpilation)
test_framework: Manual verification - no test framework (CLI tool verified by running)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install to install dependencies. 2. Run node src/index.js --help to verify CLI starts. 3. Verify worker threads spawn correctly with a dry-run or short mining session.
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/JAY-Mining. 2. npm install. 3. Copy .env.example to .env and set WALLET_ADDRESS. 4. Run node src/index.js or npm start.
environment_constraints: Node.js v18.20.8 installed via dnf. Full network access (OPEN_INTERNET). No Docker daemon available. Worker threads available in Node 18.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - no existing contribution guidelines.
key_patterns: Greenfield - establishing patterns: ES module-style CommonJS, WebSocket client with ws library, worker_threads for parallel hashing, chalk for colored output, dotenv for config.
directory_structure: Root: package.json, .env.example, README.md. src/: all source files (index.js entry point, miner.js WebSocket/mining logic, worker.js hash worker thread, config.js configuration, utils.js helpers).
